title: Tessa Dick says Philip K. Dick believed the world was a simulation
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tessa Dick says Philip K. Dick believed the world was a simulation, about 1970s-1980s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> My friend RZ Verk um who's written uh you know a couple of books about simulation theory is friends with his wife >> uh Tessadick and she talks about how he was just fully bought into the world being a simulation. you know, it's like

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says his friend Rizwan Virk, an author of books on the idea that our world is a kind of computer simulation, is friends with Tessa Dick, the wife of the science fiction writer Philip K. Dick. According to Michels, Tessa says her husband, in the 1970s and 80s, fully believed the world was a simulation, which would mean one of fiction's great minds thought reality itself was built.
